entities.summary: Scipio Africanus, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with Roman Hispania (218 BCE–19 BCE). Their legacy influenced Scipio defeats Carthaginians at Ilipa; Rome gains Hispania and Siege and fall of Numantia – symbol of Celtiberian resistance.
